generate_conformers: generate force-field-optimized 3D conformers for an RDKit molecule with optional pruning and energy minimization
compute_conformer: compute atom position features as a numpy array from a SMILES string with conformer generation
atom_to_feature_vector: extract the x, y, z coordinates of a single RDKit atom from a generated conformer
get_random_rotation_matrix: generate a random 3D rotation matrix with optional mirror symmetry for data augmentation
rotate: apply a 3D rotation matrix to a batch of vectors using TensorFlow matrix multiplication
